services.name: 2-hour lesson
services.story: The main story: a $130 2-hour lesson from the office with Grace, paid in full when booking. A late cancel or a no-show: the $20 fee may be kept. The classroom course ($199) is paid this way too.

services.name: 1-hour lesson
services.story: A $65 1-hour lesson from the office. A card is saved for the center's $20 fee, and Alex pays at the front desk after.

services.name: Road-test car
services.story: The $140 road-test car: a warm-up from the office, then the center's car at the DMV test. A $40 deposit now, and the $100 rest charged to the saved card when Grace texts DONE.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Diego and Leo (instructors who pick students up)
B.customer: Alex M. (customer, Lily's father) · other customers

services.name: Teen package: three 2-hour lessons
services.story: The main story: the $450 teen package, three 2-hour lessons with pick-up, paid in full when booking. The road-test car ($165) and single lessons can be paid this way too.

services.name: Teen package: three 2-hour lessons
services.story: The $450 teen package with a $150 deposit now, and the $300 rest charged to the saved card when Diego texts DONE after the last lesson.

services.name: 2-hour lesson with pick-up
services.story: One $179 2-hour lesson with pick-up. A card is saved and charged $179 when Diego texts DONE. A missed lesson: the $89 fee, if Sam confirms.

services_shape: lessons booked by instructor and length, with a set start; packages booked as a series of lessons; a classroom course booked by seat in a session
questions_before_times: the student's age (it sets the service: a teen package with a parent's OK, or adult lessons)
a learner's permit, and when it started
the pick-up place: a home, a school or an office, and the town
one-on-one, or another student may ride along (shared times only, where the school offers them)
for the road-test car: the DMV test date, time and place
safety_stop: a crash happening now or just now with someone hurt, a car on fire, someone trapped
the student or the instructor seems impaired by alcohol or drugs
first_steps: Parent's OK for a student under 18
Classroom hours before the first lesson
license: where the state's rules require it: a driving school license for the school, and an instructor license for each person who teaches (a switch from the state's form; most states have both)
staff_skills: teens, adults, freeway, the road-test car, the hand-control car, motorcycle; only instructors cleared for teens teach a teen; only Grace takes the center's road-test car in the example
messages_never: the permit number, the student's date of birth, health conditions and the parent's OK never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the student's record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
